description:
Mnemonic Utils

Click the image to download

>>>README<<<

Requires LazyLib, MagicLib and LunaLib

"Sensor Officer, is that sensor blip in the distance valuable salvage, or the cargo pods containing metal we dumped earlier?"

"Sorry Captain, without mnemonic sensors installed, there is absolutely no way to tell these two options apart!"

- Captain's Log, May 3rd, 217th Cycle

A mod containing exploration-themed QoL improvements. Please check the readme for details!

Gate Markers
Mnemonic Sensors
Trash Disposal
System & Hyperspace Grid Removal
Garage for Rent
A few small features
Can be added to and removed from ongoing campaigns. If removal doesn't work, disable all features via LunaSettings, save the game and then remove the mod.
Fully customizable via LunaSettings

Note: This mod was originally called MnemonicSensors and only contained that feature.
Disclaimer: The image used for Garage for Rent was generated using Craiyon (craiyon.com)

Credits

Many thanks to Genir for suggesting and providing sample implementation for system & hyperspace grid removal!
Many thanks to Tesser for contributing much prettier icons!
Many thanks to Mythic for sponsoring the Garage for Rent feature
